title: Measure one target's attainable headroom
objective: Decide numerically whether one target can produce the requested containing-region or end-to-end gain before searching kernels.
steps: Measure the production baseline and target share in the served region
Measure deletion/fusion ceiling and the relevant pure-read, copy, or launch floor
Compute latency reduction f*(1-1/s) and speedup 1/(1-f+f/s), then account for observed overlap
State one target and one causal mechanism

acceptance.pass: The target lies below the attainable ceiling by more than timing uncertainty.
acceptance.no_go: Even deletion cannot meet the target or the mechanism cannot move the limiting resource.

stop_rule: Close no-go instead of beginning a configuration sweep when the ceiling misses the target.
origin_evidence: Selected leaf operators were 2.57 ms of a 38.88 ms layer, limiting total deletion gain to 6.6%.
